notes.title: Release + 1 month | Let's recap!
notes.notes:
On February 5th, Tulips & Windmills was released on Steam as free to play. We've released six big updates and countless on-the-go fixes, localization updates, and hotfixes.

What have we achieved?

 Zoom feature
 Unlimited* amount of levels and upgrades
 *Reached a billion tulips? Get an achievement and a golden tulip, then start over with a boost. Otherwise, continue playing until your device gives up.
 Sinterklaas boost offers a 10% bonus instead of 100 tulips
 Leaderboard showing off your golden tulips and total tulip count
 Better readability of numbers (1,234,567 instead of 1234567)
 Better UI icons that don't look entirely pixelated
 Localization into Dutch, German, Turkish, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, French and Frisian
 Works on more monitor sizes and in windowed mode
 Bug and crash reporting

None of this would have been possible without your continuous support, ideas and feedback! <3

What is coming next? Take a look at our roadmap and join our Discord server to stay up to date! You can also suggest features there, report bugs, and help translate the game into different languages.

If you've enjoyed Tulips & Windmills, we would love it if you could leave a review on Steam and on Metacritic. It helps show the store page to more people on Steam.

notes.title: 1.4.4 - Hotfix of Infinity & Leaderboard
notes.notes:
Turns out infinity is not that simple! 

Many of you experienced issues with prices turning negative, leaderboards not updating anymore, or the game outright crashing. 

With this update, some of these issues have been addressed:

New way of handling numbers! You should be able to achieve a much higher score and upgrade types instead of getting negative values.
(Slight) performance improvements - let us know if you notice a difference.
Leaderboard functions differently now and supports way higher scores as well. You may still notice some values being higher than yours in the leaderboard as they are old scores.
  

In the future, we are considering offering the choice between continuing at 1 billion or resetting for a special reward and a 1% bonus for the next round (props to Puppy for the idea!).

Let us know what you think! 
Thanks for playing.

notes.title: 1.3 - Bug fixes, optimization, Turkish and Frisian!
notes.notes:
NEW
- Turkish translation
- Frisian translation
- Improved UI icons

Improvements
- UI scales better to your screen size
- Resize your window when in windowed mode
- Car no longer (de)spawns in the air
- Improved settings panel (larger dropdowns)

Bug fixes
- "Logs" button functions properly now
- Loading does no longer double your boosts
- Only one boost can be active at the same time
- Mailbox no longer gets stuck

...and a lot of under-the-hood changes for a mobile app :eyes: 
Next, a performance boost will be released sooooooon.

Please report any bugs in #bugs on our Discord server or in the community forum!
